algorithm_style: 多智能体近端策略优化 (Multi-Agent PPO, MAPPO) with 集中式训练分布式执行 (CTDE)
global_structure: 集中式训练、分布式执行 (Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution, CTDE)

environment.name: VecOffloadingEnv (车联网边缘计算仿真环境)
inputs: Actions (subtask, target, power) from N agents
internal_details: DAG Task Dynamics (依赖关系、状态转移)
Queue System (FIFO传输队列、计算队列)
Reward Engine (UNIFIED奖励方案: 时延、能耗、干扰、终止奖励)
Trust Manager (信誉评估、恶意节点模拟)
Chain Proxy (区块链结算风险代理)

policy_network.name: OffloadingPolicyNetwork (Actor)
components: DAG Embedding (节点特征、边特征、空间距离编码)
Edge-Enhanced Transformer (多头注意力 + 边偏置 + 空间偏置)
Resource Feature Encoder (资源特征编码)
Actor Head (Subtask选择 + Target选择 + Power控制)

replay_buffer.name: RolloutBuffer (经验回放缓冲区)
inputs: Active masks (区分有效决策与idle状态)
internal_details: 支持动态车辆数量 (每步agent数可变)

mappo_agent.name: MAPPOAgent (训练控制器)
internal_details: Dual Variable Update (Lagrangian约束: power, trust)

training_loop.name: Training Loop (train.py主循环)
internal_details: Pending sample accumulation (跨物理步累积奖励)
Multi-epoch PPO update (K epochs per episode)
Logit bias annealing (探索-利用平衡)
Late Guard (性能下降检测与回滚)

data_flows.data: Transition tuple $(O_t, A_t, R_t, O_{t+1}, done)$
Raw trajectories → GAE Advantages $\hat{A}_t$ and Returns $\hat{R}_t$

special_features: Parameter Sharing (所有车辆共享同一策略网络)
CTDE Architecture (集中式Critic读取global_state，分布式Actor仅用local observation)
Edge-Enhanced Transformer (边偏置 + 空间偏置增强DAG依赖建模)
Hybrid Action Space (离散Subtask/Target + 连续Power)
Conditional Power Distribution (Power分布显式依赖Target选择)
Logit Bias Annealing (Local/RSU/V2V探索偏置线性退火)
Active Sample Masking (区分有效决策与idle状态，避免无效样本污染)
Decision-level Sampling (仅在decision step采样，跨物理步累积奖励)
Dual Variable Lagrangian (约束优化: power budget, trust budget)
GAE with Dynamic Agent Count (支持每步车辆数变化)
Early Stopping based on KL Divergence (防止策略更新过大)
Late Guard Mechanism (检测性能下降并回滚到最佳checkpoint)
Rate History (rate_prev编码上步链路速率，时序信号补齐)
Trust-aware Reward (信誉评估、恶意节点惩罚)
Chain Settlement Risk (区块链确认延迟与失败风险建模)

training_paradigm.policy_update: Clipped surrogate objective with KL penalty
training_paradigm.value_update: MSE loss with optional value clipping
training_paradigm.stability: Gradient clipping + Early stopping + Value normalization

input_processing: DAG Node Embedding (comp, data, status, in_degree, location)
Resource Feature Encoding (CPU, backlog, distance, contact, competition)
network_architecture.backbone: Edge-Enhanced Transformer (Multi-head Attention + Edge Bias + Spatial Bias)
actor_heads: Subtask Head: Linear → Categorical (选择待执行子任务)
Target Head: Cross-Attention + Linear → Categorical (选择卸载目标)
Power Head: MLP → Beta(alpha, beta) (功率控制，条件于Target)
critic_heads: Value Head: Global Pooling + MLP → Scalar (状态价值)
Cost-Power Head: Global Pooling + MLP → Scalar (功率成本价值)
Cost-Trust Head: Global Pooling + MLP → Scalar (信任成本价值)
network_architecture.parameter_sharing: 所有车辆共享同一网络参数 (Parameter Sharing)
network_architecture.ctde_mechanism: Critic读取global_state (集中式训练)，Actor仅用local observation (分布式执行)

step_reward_components: Illegal action penalty: $-w_{illegal}$ (非法动作惩罚)
terminal_reward: Time limit: $-R_{fail} \cdot severity$ (超时惩罚，基于失败严重程度)
cost_signals: Power cost: 功率消耗归一化 (用于Lagrangian约束)
Trust cost: 信任失败率 (用于Lagrangian约束)

primary: Subtask Success Rate (子任务成功率)
secondary: Mean CFT (平均任务完成时间)
Deadline Miss Rate (截止时间错过率)
